title: Houston Dixie trombonists and drummers; Dixie versus tailgate
summary: Manno names Houston Dixie trombonists, explains his view of Dixie versus tailgate trombone, and praises two-beat Dixie drummers like Rome Landry.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
